header: The English / Hindi / Bengali cross-check of the archive. For every stored circular whose pages say the same thing in different scripts (English and Hindi, English and Bengali, or all three), it lists the numbers read differently on two pages (probably a misreading on one of them), the garbled longer forms of a number, and the numbers on one page only. The languages may be pages of ONE circular, or SEPARATE circulars with the same title and a language tag ("... (Eng)", "... (Hin)", "... (Beng)"): I treat a circular's family as a set of witnesses to it. It uses the text already in the database: no Gemini, no cost. See src/lib/ingestion/crossCheck.ts and currency.ts. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/crosscheck-report.ts REPORT ONLY (nothing is written to the database) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/crosscheck-report.ts --apply the same, and STORE the checks the report describes npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/crosscheck-report.ts --ids 48,85 only these circulars (also: --limit 20) What --apply STORES (table circular_page_check, the checks the answer card's gate reads): per page, the numbers two readings agree on (confirmed) and the readings the other pages contradict (unconfirmed: the answer card then REFUSES an answer that rests on one). A check a second reader (Gemini) stored for the same page text is kept and merged: what it confirmed is never marked unconfirmed. A check about other text (the page was re-read since) is replaced. I write a circular's checks for ITS OWN pages only, never for its witnesses'. Safe to run again: the same input gives the same rows. Needs DATABASE_URL.
